bullets.text: Avadi City Police arrested two men from Keralam and seized 10 kg of ganja near Poonamallee on Thursday, and the office should monitor ongoing drug trafficking enforcement.

stories.title: Two men from Keralam arrested with 10 kg of ganja near Poonamallee
takeaways: Avadi City Police arrested two men from Kerala and seized 10 kg of ganja near Poonamallee.
A special police team acted on a tip-off to intercept the narcotics trafficking operation.
